callisto-release.yml is generated (not to be hand-edited); its execute job uses group `callisto-release-execute` with cancel-in-progress false, so a middle pending run can be dropped, which is acceptable for a release job.
The 'Main is red' workflow has no concurrency of its own, so cancellation cannot skip it, and its issue already names the failing sha.
